description: Tell the user when pscat / pscat-mcp is not installed (the plugin does not bundle them).

hooks.command: command -v pscat >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v pscat-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "pscat plugin: pscat / pscat-mcp not found on PATH, so the pscat MCP tools will not start. Install them with `cargo install pscat` (or a release binary from https://github.com/jeromebanks/postscript_interpreter/releases), then restart your agent."}'
